scope: Independent metadata-only feasibility audit; no expression values or model outcomes loaded. Existing report used only for split seed.
concentration_key: Exact Decimal(raw dose_value) times a declared SI molar conversion; source_exposure uses time and ratM; paired_exposure additionally uses donor-record humanM. No approximate rounding or unit inference.
partition_contract: Existing five outer fold assignments preserved. Three inner assignments derived on each COMPLETE original outer-training compound set with original seed20261107+1009*(outer+1), before exchangeability filtering.
eligibility_rule: Within the current partition, retain only strata with at least two different compounds. All observed strata have no repeated compound, so full bijective derangements are feasible.
interpretation: Source-exposure mismatch holds donor rat measurement time and administered molar concentration equal to query, while all query chemical/context features remain original.
Donor-paired human concentration is not supplied to the query; its equality is a stricter secondary restriction.
Administered molar concentration equality does not establish equal intracellular exposure.
Twenty predetermined mismatch seeds are a sensitivity ensemble, not biological replication or an exact conditional-randomization p-value.
212 primary eligible test rows belong to two-member strata; these rows admit only one wrong donor. Save duplicate-map diagnostics.
Rowwise exchanges do not preserve a fixed donor-compound mapping across a query compound entire time/dose trajectory.
Chemical structure and animal-response conditional distribution is intentionally broken by this negative control; causal or formal-exchangeability claims are not established.
Performance is evaluated on the metadata-eligible cohort defined for each partition.
